The engine power plant was the failed component, with the LRD activation and oil tube dislodgement causing smoke, as the engine-level failure mode in the precedents.

Smoke entering the flight deck from the engine area through bleed air or engine pathways relates to the fire protection and smoke-handling system, though the packet does not establish a fire protection defect.

queries: bird ingestion into engine during initial climb causing fan imbalance and smoke in cockpit
engine fan blade damage from bird strike leading to oil loss and smoke entering flight deck
flight crew response to smoke in cockpit after engine fire switch pulled during climb
